study: exploratory mechanistic causal study; not prospective prediction
hypothesis: Legal early enqueue changes long-term CDCL cost by displacing a near-future baseline branch
decision_followup: Track next 8 actual decisions separately from first-fate stopping rule; maximum 10000 semantic events
fate_stop: Earliest assignment (decision/natural propagation/other), conflict, restart, or 10000 events
controls: Same exact state, frozen legal NON-HIGH action, lowest frozen action rank; unavailable if none
inclusion: Auditable exact state and action, full continuation, verified >=10% absolute remaining analysis-ops effect, VERIFIED proof or equivalent soundness; exclude historical states without provable exact replay equivalence
rank: Activity rank uses average ties among all variables; heap rank is 1-based native semantic pop order; current branch candidate filters assigned/non-decision variables without mutating heap
event_alignment: Ordered semantic events after checkpoint; omit only intervention enqueue and its immediate heap/activity consequence from downstream classification. Report raw first mismatch and assignment/decision/conflict projections. Natural enqueue of the intervention literal is a schedule mismatch, not by itself evidence of branch causality. No post-hoc resynchronization to prefer branch-first.
restoration: Only eligible when HIGH cancels/replaces/delays an identifiable baseline branch within next 8 decisions. At corresponding ordinal treatment decision, force baseline literal only if unassigned and decision eligible. Never undo an implication or force an assigned variable. First eligible displaced branch only; record impossible/no-op separately from performed restoration.
suppression: For eligible identified displaced baseline branch, at its baseline ordinal decision skip that variable once and pick next native heap candidate. Reinsert skipped variable with native insertion. Preserve native polarity; if no alternative, record unavailable.
counterfactual_validation: Same checkpoint canonical hashes for v3; full UNSAT continuation and independent proof verification; observers must reproduce original route counters and proof hash before causal interpretation
restoration_weakens_effect: Descriptive attenuation 1 - abs(restore_cost-baseline_cost)/abs(high_cost-baseline_cost); >=0.5 is substantial attenuation, frozen before outcomes
suppression_reproduction: Report signed cost-shift ratio and decision/learned prefix agreement; >=0.5 same-direction HIGH shift is partial cost reproduction, never sufficient alone
result_A: Multiple auditable HIGH actions including historical replication show near branch relevance, branch-consistent first downstream divergence, and >=1 legal restoration substantially attenuates effect
result_B: Auditable replicated evidence weakens direct branch carrier: variables naturally propagate before branching, pre-decision divergence, and/or valid counterfactual non-reproduction
result_C: Insufficient auditable mechanism cases or legal identifying counterfactuals; do not infer mechanism from missing experiments
sealed_artifacts: Read only; no old labels modified
